bloodlines.arcana: Water spells use an effective caster level 1 higher, and your summoned creatures with a swim speed or the aquatic or water subtype gain +1 morale on attack and damage rolls.

powers.name: Dehydrating Touch
powers.summary: Make a melee touch attack for 1d6 nonlethal damage plus 1 per two sorcerer levels and sicken the target for 1 round; oozes, plants, and aquatic or water creatures take lethal damage. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Aquatic Adaptation
powers.summary: Gain a 30-foot swim speed. At 9th level gain amphibious, +1 natural armor, cold resistance 5, and blindsense 30 feet underwater; at 15th gain a 60-foot swim speed and blindsense 60 feet underwater.

powers.name: Aquatic Telepathy
powers.summary: Gain 100-foot telepathy with creatures that swim or have the aquatic or water type and use suggestion on them Charisma-modifier times per day; at 15th level call one for service once per day.

powers.name: Raise the Deep
powers.summary: Once per day create stationary water as control water for one round per sorcerer level even where no water exists; double its dimensions at 20th level.

powers.name: Deep One
powers.summary: Gain blindsense 60 feet, DR 10/piercing, cold resistance 20, continuous freedom of movement, and underwater evasion, blindsight 120 feet, and immunity to deep-water pressure.

bloodlines.arcana: Increase the save DC of every spell you cast with the cold descriptor by 1.

powers.name: Cold Steel
powers.summary: Give a touched weapon or up to 50 ammunition the frost property for half your sorcerer level in rounds; at 9th level grant icy burst for half the duration. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Icewalker
powers.summary: Gain cold resistance 5 and cross snow and ice without penalty or tracks; at 9th level gain cold resistance 10 and climb ice as spider climb.

powers.name: Snow Shroud
powers.summary: Ignore concealment and Perception penalties from snow, ice, and fog, and surround yourself with a cold fire-shield-like shroud that also grants 20% miss chance and a snowy-area Stealth bonus.

powers.name: Blizzard
powers.summary: Once per day create a control-winds storm centered on you whose outer area also functions as sleet storm and exposes creatures to extreme cold.

powers.name: Child of Ancient Winters
powers.summary: Gain the cold subtype, immunity to fatigue, exhaustion, sneak attacks, and critical hits, and vulnerability to fire.
